description: The bar chart displays the count of different types of reasoning outputs across two models: “Mistral 7B” and an unlabeled model represented by a gray bar on the far left. The x-axis, labeled “Model,” lists these two models as categorical labels. The y-axis, labeled “Count,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 120, with major tick marks at intervals of 20. A legend in the upper left identifies five categories: Type1 (teal), Type2 (orange), Type3 (blue), RR (pink), and WW (green). For the unlabeled model, only Type1 (count ≈15), Type2 (count ≈25), and RR (count ≈120) are shown, with Type3 and WW absent (count = 0). For Mistral 7B, Type1 (count ≈28), Type2 (count ≈25), RR (count ≈115), and WW (count ≈30) are present, while Type3 remains absent. The RR category dominates in both models, with counts near 120, while other types show much lower frequencies.
